text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Two main Portuguese union to unite behind European Confederation of Unions' call for demonstrations in favour of employment on May 28.
- French group Leclerc plans to offer cut-price petrol at its hypermarket in Valongo, northern Portugal, in order to attract more clients.
- General Workers Union (UGT) says next big target will be to cut working week to 35 hours.
- Luxury tourism project Verde Lago approved for Castro Marim in the Algarve. Investment amounts to 18 billion escudos and may create a thousand jobs.

- The International Mozambique Bank (BIM), in which BCP/Atlantico has a stake, is preparing to go into the investment banking, project finance and risk capital in Mozambique with the support of investment bank Cisf.
- The board of state cereal company EPAC prepares a recovery plan to deal with debt problem.
